node.title: High-core collision-line basis ledger
node.statement: For a syndrome-line error family of affine rank s, every size-k collision line has core-restriction rank s-1. If b_ell counts its independent (s-1)-minors, then sum_ell b_ell<=C(n,s-1), while each line contains at most floor((n-k)/(A-k)) errors. A minimum-basis line with b_*=b puts the whole affine family in a fixed chart of excess at most b+s-2 and self-localizes the line ledger to |P_hi|<=L floor(C(min(n,R+b+s-2),s-1)/b). This closes rank four on RowC 1/4 and prize 1/4,1/8 before the cogirth handoff.
